subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only linked PR be enough to resolve this issue, or should this issue remain open for registry-derived enum support?
rationale: The source gap is clear and the narrow PR addresses the description problem, but enum support could affect dynamic channel/plugin ids and needs maintainer scope before being treated as required.

options.title: Accept Description-Only Resolution
options.body: Land the linked PR, close this issue when merged, and open or leave a separate follow-up only if maintainers still want dynamic enum support.

options.title: Require Enum In This Issue
options.body: Keep this issue open after the description PR until registry-derived enum behavior is designed and implemented.

options.title: Split The Scope Explicitly
options.body: Retitle or comment that this issue covers schema wording only, then create a separate product/API discussion for enum constraints.

recommendation.title: Accept Description-Only Resolution
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR, close this issue when merged, and open or leave a separate follow-up only if maintainers still want dynamic enum support.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed the issue scope and has recent history across the message-tool and outbound-channel boundary.
